question: For the matrices $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\-3&4\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\5&0\end{bmatrix},\quad C=\begin{bmatrix}-4&3\\1&-2\end{bmatrix},$$ evaluate $(A+B)+C$ and $A+(B+C)$ and thereby establish the associative property of matrix addition for the given matrices.
explanation:
Evaluation of the First Grouping

First calculate $A+B$. We get $$A+B=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\-3&4\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\5&0\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\2&4\end{bmatrix}$$ Therefore, $$(A+B)+C=\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\2&4\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-4&3\\1&-2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-1&4\\3&2\end{bmatrix}$$

Evaluation of the Second Grouping

Now, $$B+C=\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\5&0\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-4&3\\1&-2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-2&2\\6&-2\end{bmatrix}$$ Hence, $$A+(B+C)=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\-3&4\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-2&2\\6&-2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-1&4\\3&2\end{bmatrix}$$

Final Result

Since both groupings give the same matrix, $$(A+B)+C=A+(B+C)=\begin{bmatrix}-1&4\\3&2\end{bmatrix}$$ Therefore, the associative property of matrix addition is verified for the given matrices.
